llm.summary: This skill clearly describes a Kia account MCP integration for reading vehicle data and sending confirm-gated vehicle commands, with sensitive access disclosed.

dimensions.detail: Requested account credentials, MFA bootstrap, Kia API network access, and vehicle command authority are proportionate to the vehicle-control functionality described.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses npx to run the external npm package kiaaccess-mcp and requires Kia credentials in environment variables; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned but users should trust the package source before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill handles high-impact actions such as unlocking a vehicle and reading vehicle location, but it repeatedly requires explicit confirmation for commands and warns not to guess vehicle identifiers or expose secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses a locally stored remember-me token that refreshes sessions silently and provides a confirm-gated forget-session tool; token export is explicitly described as sensitive and not for routine checks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to let a user access and command their own Kia vehicle; status, location, EV charge, climate, charging, and lock/unlock capabilities are coherent with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving this MCP server access to your Kia account, vehicle location, and remote vehicle controls. Prefer KIA_WRITE_MODE=none for read-only use, use all only if you need lock/unlock, and avoid exporting or sharing the refresh token.
